nodes.description: Public mapping (string => uint256) holding packed value/timestamp pairs written by the oracle updater and read by getValue.
Address holding the sole privileged account allowed to call setValue and updateOracleUpdaterAddress.
Constructor that initializes oracleUpdater to msg.sender, granting deployer full control of the oracle.
Privileged function that packs a uint128 value and timestamp into a uint256 and writes it into the values mapping.
Public view function that unpacks the stored uint256 into a value and timestamp pair.
Privileged function that transfers the oracleUpdater role to a new address, changing the access-control authority.
msg.sender as consumed by the constructor to assign the initial privileged updater.
msg.sender as checked in the setValue require statement gating the privileged write.
msg.sender as checked in the updateOracleUpdaterAddress require statement gating the privilege transfer.
State write values[key] = cValue in setValue, mutating oracle data read by third-party consumers.
State write oracleUpdater = newOracleUpdaterAddress in updateOracleUpdaterAddress, reassigning the privileged role.
Arithmetic packing cValue = (uint256(value) << 128) + timestamp with no overflow/range validation.
Arithmetic unpacking in getValue using cValue % 2**128 and cValue >> 128.
String key parameter of setValue, used as the values mapping index.
uint128 value parameter of setValue, shifted left by 128 during packing.
uint128 timestamp parameter of setValue, caller-supplied time value added into the packed word.
String key parameter of getValue, used to index the values mapping.
Address parameter newOracleUpdaterAddress written into the oracleUpdater privilege slot.
Local cValue in setValue holding the packed (value << 128) + timestamp result.
Local cValue in getValue holding the raw storage word read from values[key].
Local value in getValue holding cValue >> 128 which is returned to the caller.
Local timestamp in getValue holding cValue % 2**128 which is returned to the caller.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to establish the privileged oracleUpdater account.
Constructor writes oracleUpdater from msg.sender, defining the access-control authority.
msg.sender is compared with oracleUpdater inside setValue's require, gating the privileged write.
setValue reads the oracleUpdater state variable to authorize the caller.
msg.sender is compared with oracleUpdater inside updateOracleUpdaterAddress's require.
updateOracleUpdaterAddress reads oracleUpdater to authorize the privilege transfer.
updateOracleUpdaterAddress executes the state write that reassigns the privileged role.
newOracleUpdaterAddress parameter flows into the oracleUpdater assignment.
The unsafe write mutates the oracleUpdater access-control state variable.
key parameter is passed into setValue.
value parameter is passed into setValue.
Caller-supplied timestamp parameter is accepted and persisted as an authoritative time value without validation.
setValue executes the packing arithmetic that builds cValue.
value participates in the left-shift of the packing expression.
timestamp is added into the packed word with no range or overflow check.
Unsafe encoding operation produces the local cValue (shift plus addition).
Local cValue is stored into the values mapping through the unsafe write.
key parameter is used as the mapping index of the unsafe write.
setValue executes the values[key] state write.
The unsafe write mutates the values state variable.
key parameter is passed into getValue.
getValue reads the values state variable for the requested key.
Packed storage word is decoded with modulo and right-shift operations.
Decoding operation produces the local cValue in getValue.
Local timestamp is derived from cValue using modulo 2**128.
Local value is derived from cValue using a right shift by 128.
Unpacked value is returned by getValue.
Unpacked timestamp is returned by getValue.

normalization_plan.reason: The key parameter is only a syntactic input of setValue and is fully represented by the setValue function node.
The value parameter exists solely to feed the setValue function body and is abstracted by the setValue node.
The timestamp parameter is scoped to setValue and is subsumed by the setValue function node.
The key parameter is a local input of getValue and collapses into the getValue function node.
newOracleUpdaterAddress is only meaningful inside updateOracleUpdaterAddress and merges into that privileged function node.
The local cValue is the direct result of the packing arithmetic and is represented by that unsafe operation node.
The local cValue in getValue is produced by the modular/shift decoding and is represented by that unsafe operation node.
The local value is a by-product of the same decoding arithmetic and folds into the decoding unsafe operation node.
The local timestamp is a by-product of the same decoding arithmetic and folds into the decoding unsafe operation node.
